violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. - Flour found on floor in storage area.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Sides and under all equipment in kitchen needs to be cleaned. - Handles of all equipment needs to be cleaned. - Inside of reach-in cooler on cook line needs to be cleaned. - Metal rack next to fry station needs to be deep cleaned. - Racks in reach-in in server station needs to be cleaned, discoloration showing on the racks. - Salad bar needs to be deep cleaned on the inside, discoloration where ice is building up.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Three compartment sink was not maintained or operated in the approved three step method. - At time of inspection staff was not operating in the correct order of dishwashing.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. - No soap at hand wash sink at time of inspection.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors in kitchen are in need of deep clean. - Walls behind cook top needs to be cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Missing tiles on kitchen floor.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Sides of all equipment in kitchen needs to be cleaned. - Handles of all equipment needs to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - Togo items on the floor in storage area. - TP found on the floor in storage area.
